scope: References only, no third-party screenshots/code/fonts/assets bundled or fetched.
guidance: Use sources for design questions and inspect the live reference yourself. Code, assets, screenshots, fonts and layouts require per-file rights review. Neither public viewability nor an open source repository implies visual asset reuse permission.

sources.title: Awwwards
sources.study_question: Study distinctive composition, interaction rhythm, structure and the purpose of visual effects. Awards are not evidence of accessibility.

sources.title: SiteInspire
sources.study_question: Compare typography, gutters, content sequencing and industry-specific visual language. Avoid copying arrangements.

sources.title: One Page Love
sources.study_question: Study narrative sequence and truthful proof-to-CTA flow; adapt for product-specific content.

sources.title: Mobbin
sources.study_question: Study shipped mobile/web screen states, search/checkout/onboarding flows, task density and navigation.

sources.title: Refero
sources.study_question: Compare real product SaaS pages, filters, tables and subscription/checkout states.

sources.title: Page Flows
sources.study_question: Review complete task sequences and error/recovery interaction; screens are not reusable assets.

sources.title: Game UI Database
sources.study_question: Study HUD priority, game menu hierarchies, inventory patterns and result screens. Game screenshots remain third-party content.

sources.title: Godot official demo projects
sources.study_question: Run official GUI demos at the project-pinned engine version; examine input and state handling.

sources.title: Unity UI Toolkit code examples
sources.license_note: License and asset terms require file-level verification
sources.study_question: Study runtime UXML/USS styling, ListView and responsive UI. Repository examples are not standalone games.

sources.title: IBM Carbon
sources.study_question: Learn enterprise density, typographic roles, interactive states, spacing and data table hierarchy.

sources.title: Adobe React Aria
sources.license_note: License must be checked per selected package
sources.study_question: Use as a behavioral accessibility and internationalization reference; separate styling from semantic interaction.

sources.title: Radix Primitives
sources.study_question: Study composable accessible primitives, focus and keyboard behavior, without adopting default styling.

sources.title: shadcn/ui
sources.study_question: Study open, adaptable component architecture. Do not mistake its example theme for a product identity.

sources.title: Microsoft Fluent UI
sources.study_question: Study stateful controls, high-density work surfaces and accessible feedback.

sources.title: Vercel Web Interface Guidelines
sources.license_note: Guide license must be checked before copying text
sources.study_question: Review interaction, content, focus, semantic HTML, motion, image and performance hygiene.

sources.title: Playwright Visual Comparisons
sources.license_note: Documentation usage; do not copy code/assets without checking terms
sources.study_question: Use reproducible screenshot and target-size comparisons; baseline renders must share environment.

sources.title: axe-core
sources.study_question: Audit semantic and accessible HTML; automated results do not establish full accessibility.

sources.title: Godot GUI Docs
sources.study_question: Study Control node layout, themes, scalable interfaces and locale handling.
